'''Woqua''' was an object located within the [[Woqua system/Legends|Woqua system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[16 ABY/Legends|Twelve years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Plat Mallar]] escaped a [[Yevetha]]n [[Battle of Polneye|attack]] on the planet [[Polneye]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] and desperately tried to reach [[Galantos]]. A passing ship bound for Woqua intercepted Mallar's signal, and the [[Fian/Legends|people]] of Galantos grew concerned after hearing of the Yevethan attack on the nearby planet.<ref name="BS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Woqua was first mentioned in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Before the Storm]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="BS" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Woqua system/Legends|Woqua star system]] and the object itself in grid square K-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
